# Agent Plugin Forge

For skill intake, creation, copying, bundling, or publication, read and follow `plugins/agent-plugin-forge/skills/package-agent-skill/SKILL.md`.

Use `uv run forge`; do not hand-edit generated marketplaces or Codex compatibility wrappers. Preserve imported skill trees byte-for-byte, keep provenance outside the copied tree, and never execute imported content during intake.

Run Ruff, ty, pytest, the forge validator, and strict Zensical build before opening a pull request.
